amendmentHistory.change: Replaced the invalid [0, 99000] explicit geometry axis with the required [0, 100000] boundary-complete axis.
amendmentHistory.resultInspection: The first execution terminated before emitting a report. No candidate metrics, thresholds, rankings, or acceptance rules were changed or inspected.

amendmentHistory.observedFailure: The containing-lower construction lookup made transported fields piecewise constant, amplified spatial error through recurrence, and made uniform 15-point transport highly phase-sensitive to cell crossings.
amendmentHistory.predeclaredCorrection: Use the flat geometry's existing clamped bilinear z/rho stencil for both construction and final-view sampling, retain the user-selected 15-interval controls as explicit selected inputs, and screen larger nonuniform domains under resource limits calibrated against the accepted spherical cache instead of the arbitrary v1 8 MiB cap.
amendmentHistory.candidateOutputInspection: No bilinear-construction candidate or v2 control output was executed or inspected before this v2 policy was written. The v1 thresholds remain unchanged.

amendmentHistory.observedAttribution: The altitude-complete z19/rho6 candidate reduced J1 normalized L-infinity to 0.035946 but still left later-order error at 0.624812, while the radial-heavy candidate retained large J1 error because it omitted required altitude nodes. This identifies a combined z19 plus refined-rho follow-up without changing error limits.
amendmentHistory.predeclaredCorrection: Hold the v2 z19 axis fixed, screen nested rho9/rho13/rho15 candidates against a rho17 production-owner reference, retain additional radial nodes as withheld probes, and choose the smallest passing candidate before any v3 output is observed.
amendmentHistory.controlDisposition: Both 15-interval controls remain measured against 60 and retain their original limits. They are selected-control characterizations, not post-hoc gates that may override the user's pre-existing production-15 selection. A failure remains a documented accuracy limitation even if a spatial domain is identified.
amendmentHistory.candidateOutputInspection: No z19/rho9, z19/rho13, z19/rho15, or rho17-reference v3 output was executed or inspected before this policy was written. Numerical thresholds are unchanged from v1 and v2.

amendmentHistory.observedAttribution: The completed v3 rho13 and rho15 candidates shared their J2 and J3 worst spectrum at radial-withheld-observer-side:w3-4, whose withheld radius is 4,500,000 meters. Their J4 and Jthrough4 worst spectrum remained radial-withheld-source-subpoint:w3-31, whose withheld radius is 50,000 meters. Adding the 900,000- and 1,500,000-meter nodes in rho15 did not change those worst locations or the shared J2/J3 maxima.
amendmentHistory.predeclaredCorrection: Hold the v3 z19 and rho13 axes fixed, then test adding 50,000 meters alone, 4,500,000 meters alone, and both observed worst-point radii together. Retain the rho17 reference and choose the smallest passing candidate under the unchanged selection rule.
amendmentHistory.diagnosticExpansion: For each spatial field and candidate, retain the ten worst spectra ordered deterministically by normalized L-infinity, comparison id, and original comparison ordinal. This is diagnostic detail only; the existing worstSpectrum record and every acceptance calculation remain unchanged.
amendmentHistory.controlDisposition: Both selected 15-interval controls, their 60-interval references, their non-gating disposition, and their original limits remain unchanged. The W9 study, 285-position cap, and logical resource ceilings also remain unchanged.
amendmentHistory.candidateOutputInspection: No v4 rho13 baseline, single-node rho14, combined-node rho15, or top-ten diagnostic output was executed or inspected before this policy was written.

amendmentHistory.verificationPurpose: Re-run the exact v4 rho17 reference, stress probes, numerical gates, control characterizations, angular study, and resource gates against the promoted production defaults and current production source hashes.
amendmentHistory.selectionDisposition: This v5 policy contains only the already-promoted current production position domain. It verifies default-node realization, current-source identity, numerical reproduction, and logical resources after promotion; it does not reopen or perform position-domain reselection.
amendmentHistory.candidateOutputInspection: No post-promotion v5 spatial, control, outgoing, resource, source-hash, or default-realization output was executed or inspected before this policy was written.

claimBoundary.purpose: Post-promotion Stage 9 verification of the configured flat/local production cache domain, current production source hashes, selected defaults, and logical resources.
claimBoundary.authority: The runner calls the production FlatEarthGeometry, LocalSunLightSource, LocalSun CPU field, transport, resident-cache, and cubed-sphere owners. It does not implement a second cache.
claimBoundary.starBoundary: Algorithm32-star has no integrated flat/local cache, so Star is not used as a cache-output oracle here.
claimBoundary.configurationBoundary: The 100 km atmosphere and 4.8 Mm point-source case is a configured diagnostic case, not a universal production physical default.
claimBoundary.diagnosticDomainBoundary: W3 is used only to isolate position-domain and transport-control behavior. A separate W9-to-W27 primary-field refinement check uses the production cubed-sphere owners; production intentionally has no denser W owner.
claimBoundary.selectedControlBoundary: The production transport count of 15 is an explicit project selection based on the user's cited production reference, not a value this post-selection verification may silently replace. Both 15-to-60 differentials remain visible characterizations and unresolved accuracy limitations. Post-promotion spatial verification still requires the unchanged numerical limits.
claimBoundary.verificationBoundary: The only position candidate is the v4-selected and now-promoted production domain. This run may verify or reject that promoted realization under the frozen gates, but it does not select a replacement.
claimBoundary.scientificBoundary: These are predeclared project engineering limits, not published physical-error tolerances or a scientific-validation claim.

reference.interpretation: Every declared stress position is an exact reference node. The v2 altitude-complete axis is held fixed while the promoted rho15 domain omits two declared reference nodes, so the comparison retains the v4 radial recurrence and interpolation surface. The result is a denser production-owner comparison surface, not a continuous-cache oracle.

spectrumMetric.percentileDefinition: nearest-rank with one-based rank ceil(p * sampleCount), clamped to the final sorted sample

diagnostics.acceptanceRole: Diagnostic only. Preserve worstSpectrum and all maximum, percentile, finite, nonnegative, and pass calculations unchanged.

spatialStudy.acceptance: The promoted position domain passes verification only if every compared field satisfies both spectrum limits and every sampled scalar is finite and nonnegative.

sourceTransmittance.selectionAuthority: User-confirmed production count of 15 backed by an existing project reference; retain the measured 15-to-60 differential without post-hoc threshold weakening.

storedFieldTransport.selectionAuthority: User-confirmed production transport count of 15 backed by an existing project reference; retain the measured 15-to-60 differential without post-hoc threshold weakening.

outgoingStudy.acceptanceInterpretation: Passing shows that even W9 reconstructs the sampled local primary field within the declared limits, so retained W27 is conservatively finer on this diagnostic. Failure rejects W9 but cannot by itself estimate or reject W27 because production intentionally exposes no denser cubed-sphere owner.
outgoingStudy.scope: This does not reselect the already accepted Fibonacci-34 incident quadrature and does not claim a direct beyond-W27 convergence bound.

resourceCriteria.defaultPositionDomainRequirement: Omitted FlatEarthGeometry cache axes must realize the productionSelection.position z/rho meter arrays exactly before the logical resource gate passes.

fieldPeakModel.reason: Conservative N4 reflective-graph live-field bound before an output pass releases its inputs.

resourceCriteria.packedTransportTapUpperBoundReason: At most four z/rho position taps times four W taps at each of transportIntervalCount + 1 trapezoid points.
resourceCriteria.budgetRationale: The accepted spherical/distant cache already retains 12,597,120 bytes and reports 44,562,816 peak tracked bytes. Post-promotion v5 retains v4's ceiling of at most 80 MiB resident and 448 MiB tracked for the selected 285-position finite-source domain and four-position-by-four-direction packed transport stencils. These are explicit logical ceilings, not supported-hardware qualification.
resourceCriteria.qualificationBoundary: Logical production-owner resource accounting only; driver overhead, supported-hardware timing, and release performance remain later qualification.

selectionRule.fallbackEligibility: No fallback is declared in v5. The promoted current domain must pass every spatial field and both resource limits. Both selected 15-interval controls remain reported characterizations and accuracy limitations under their explicit authority rather than post-selection vetoes. The W9-to-W27 study remains supporting angular-refinement evidence under its separately declared claim boundary.
selectionRule.passingFallbackOrder: No fallback order is active because v5 contains only the promoted current production domain.
selectionRule.failureRule: If the promoted current grid fails, report no passing production domain. Do not weaken criteria, select a replacement, or silently change production.

report.determinism: No timestamp, duration, process id, absolute workspace path, or unseeded sample enters the report. Ordered inputs and results are hashed with SHA-256.
report.diagnosticRetention: Every spatial field/candidate retains worstSpectrum unchanged and adds worstSpectra containing at most ten rows ordered by normalized L-infinity descending, comparison id by UTF-16 code unit ascending, and original comparison ordinal ascending. worstSpectra is diagnostic-only and does not enter acceptance calculations.
